title: 叫號機
question:
餐廳門口的叫號機：先來的先叫，這就是 queue（先進先出）。
請先輸入有幾個操作，再輸入每個操作：大於 0 的數字代表那個號碼的客人來排隊；0 代表叫號，輸出排在最前面的號碼並讓他離開隊伍。沒有人在排隊時，輸出「沒有人在排隊」。

test_case.output:
沒有人在排隊
7
沒有人在排隊
test_case.note: 一開始和最後都沒有人

en.title: Ticket Machine
en.question:
A restaurant calls numbers. First come, first served: this is a queue (first in, first out).
First input the number of actions. Then input each action: a number > 0 means that customer joins the line. 0 means call the next one: output the first number and remove it. If nobody is in line, output "Nobody in line".

test_case.output:
Nobody in line
7
Nobody in line
test_case.note: Nobody at the start and at the end
